palette.notes: Measured palette_size 19 with two ramps (hue shift median ~80, median length 9.5). Nearly monochrome cyan-teal world; the only warm colours are the orange-pink Christmas tree lights and a few coloured windows.

lighting: Cold ambient winter light everywhere; warm points of light (tree, windows) are the focus. The cat is pure dark silhouette against the bright window.
silhouette: Black cat from behind, ears and head breaking into the window: the strongest, simplest shape in the frame, nearly all one value.

motion.timing: Measured only 2 changes over 12.82 s (median hold 3333 ms): effectively a still image. Any twinkle or snow is below the change threshold on this copy.

texture: Fine pixel detail in snow-covered trees and the block of flats; light dithering (dither_share 0.0015) in the haze.
camera: Locked shot over the cat's shoulder; foreground window frame on the left and sill at the bottom frame the view.

acting.acts: The cat just sits and watches the city; the acting is the pose, back turned, looking at the warm tree.
acting.depth: Three clear planes: dark cat and window in front, mid-ground flats with coloured windows, foggy towers far back fading into cyan.

techniques: over-the-shoulder silhouette: character from behind looking into the scene
monochrome cool world + one warm focal light (the tree)
atmospheric perspective: far buildings lose contrast into the sky colour
foreground framing with a dark window edge
near-static loop with almost no changes
feel: cold cyan world + one warm tree + black cat from behind = quiet cozy longing
for_fred: Give Pixie a still beat from behind: a dark silhouette in the foreground looking at something warm in the scene, held for 2-3 s with no motion, before the next action; stillness makes the busy moments land.
